## History

Minnie May is the young baby sister of [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). While her parents were away, she fell severely ill with the croup, prompting [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to run to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to beg for assistance. [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) used her past experience with young children to nurse Minnie May through the night until [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) arrived with a doctor, an act of care that saved the baby's life and convinced Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) to forgive [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for a previous grievance.

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--minnie-may.md)

When Minnie May fell severely ill with croup while her parents were away, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) used her past experience with young children to treat the baby through the night until a doctor arrived. This act saved Minnie May's life and earned [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) the gratitude and forgiveness of Minnie May's mother, Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md). As Minnie May grows older, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) continues to interact with her as a trusted family friend, occasionally taking her and the other local children out on outings like rowboat rides.

- Saved by  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043)</sub>
